name: ai-vastra-crm-backend
description: AI Vastra CRM Backend - WhatsApp Real-Time Sync Engine

scripts.view-whatsapp-leads: node -e "const { db } = require('./dist/store'); db.initSqlData().then(() => { const list = db.getAllChatsSorted().filter(c => (!c.jid || (!c.jid.includes('@instagram') && !c.jid.includes('@linkedin') && !c.jid.includes('@facebook'))) && (c.leadStatus !== 'UNASSIGNED' || c.notes || c.followUpDate || c.manuallySaved)); console.table(list.map(c => ({ 'Name / Phone': c.name || c.phone || c.jid, 'JID': c.jid, 'Lead Status': c.leadStatus || 'UNASSIGNED', 'BDM': c.assignedUser || '—', 'Follow-Up Date': c.followUpDate || '—', 'Notes': (c.notes || '').replace(/\n/g, ' ').slice(0, 35) }))); process.exit(0); });"
